verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerts overview says any signal can be configured to alert "if it exhibits abnormal behavior" as an alternative to a threshold, which directly covers anomaly detection without hand-written thresholds. AI insights summaries of workload health and potential issues add some secondary support for surfacing problems automatically. The evidence is a single short first-party line, though, with no detail on how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of the anomaly/baseline detection mechanics and sensitivity tuning, any evidence of outlier detection across entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
